title: If Jesus is truly the Son of God, His words are not suggestions.
paragraphs: If Jesus is truly the Son of God, His words are not suggestions.

They are truth.
They are life.
They are judgment.
You cannot ignore Him and still claim Him.

Most people say they believe in Jesus…
but ignore half of what He said.
If He really is the Son of God, that’s not just disagreement.

Do people believe in Jesus…
or just the version of Him they prefer?
